title: FLA import: library folder structure hardcoded empty — not decoded from binary
description: In flash8-import.ts, the library output is always { items, folders: [] } — the folders array is hardcoded empty. The model already supports LibraryFolder with id/name/parentFolderId. The FLA binary likely encodes folder structure in the Contents stream. Fix: in flash8-binary.ts, examine the Contents stream parsing code to find where library folder groups are stored (they may be encoded as a special stream entry type or as part of the item list). Decode folder entries and return them via Fla8Contents. In flash8-import.ts, convert them to LibraryFolder objects.
